rationale: Artem's deep expertise in ML inference optimization and vision-language models (loopvlm, transformers) directly complements Ruyi Dynamics' humanoid robotics work, where efficient on-device vision and real-time model inference are critical. Tom is building robotics hardware that will need exactly the kind of ML systems infrastructure and computer vision tooling Artem has shipped in open-source projects.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Tom Zhanh — he's building humanoid robots at Ruyi Dynamics and could benefit from your ML inference and vision-language model expertise.
